Container.Name: hearth
Container.Overview: Family location sharing you host yourself. A live map, arrival and departure alerts for places, SOS, check-ins and crash detection, for the Hearth iOS and Android app. No account with anyone, no analytics. Needs a Postgres database, and a reverse proxy with TLS before you invite people from outside your network.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The API and the admin portal.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Where phones reach Hearth, such as https://hearth.example.com behind your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Admin email
Config.Description: The admin account, created on the first start. It is the only way in.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: At least 10 characters. Only read on the first start.

Config.Name: Token secret
Config.Description: 32 or more random characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 48

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: true when a reverse proxy terminates TLS in front of Hearth.

Config.Name: Who can sign up
Config.Description: invite: only with an invite code from a circle.
